primary_sources.title: Character Sums and Congruences with n!

primary_sources.supports: For a fixed nonzero residue modulo a prime, the number of factorial hits in an interval of length N is O(N^(2/3)).
primary_sources.does_not_support: No normalized collision core, prime-power valuation identity, weighted endpoint residue, or irrationality conclusion.

primary_sources.supports: Prime and general-modulus hit-count bounds; with q=p^e, direct prime-power reuse control and aggregate p-adic load estimates.

primary_sources.title: Distribution of factorials modulo p
primary_sources.supports: A short-interval O(N^(3/4)) bound for solutions of (n!)^2=P(n) mod p; P=1 bounds plus/minus-one factorial hits.
primary_sources.does_not_support: It is weaker for the present fixed-prime multiplicity purpose than the assimilated O(N^(2/3)) bound and gives no weighted global closure.
